rule: Only these exact files may be published. No wildcard permission. Every private/ file is excluded, including headers, PDFs, full extracts and raw web/API bodies.
explicit_own_control_exception: Own prose, exact source/runtime/inventory metadata, standalone own controls/verifiers and their safe receipts are allowed.
supersedes: public/SAFE_PUBLIC_ALLOWLIST.json is a preserved historical checkpoint, and this V2 allowlist is the sole operative exact public permission.
integrity_rule: V2 manifest hashes every ordinary retained file, including all prior checkpoint files; detached manifest SHA is external to that manifest; V2 complete recursive inventory hashes all but itself, with its self-hash reported externally.
